title: Dynegy Moss Landing Power Plant Hybrid: CPUC Generation Audit of Moss Landing Power Plant
summary: CPUC staff audited Moss Landing Power Plant during March 3-7, 2025 and identified potential GO 167-B violations requiring a response. Entity use: The three-year EIA capacity panel is followed by a 2025 CPUC site audit and operator response. The later records add safety and compliance constraints, but the plant-wide audit cannot be reduced to a performance score for every battery generator at plant code 260.
key_findings: The report records regulator-observed operations, equipment inspection, document review, and staff interviews at the site.
Temporal role: CPUC conducted an on-site generation audit with equipment inspection, document review, and staff interviews.
Attribution: CPUC attributes the findings; the operator attributes the responses and corrective actions.
why_it_matters: This entity-matched record adds a named driver, control, input, constraint, or later observation to a Phase 56B panel without treating sequence as causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the parent panel's stable entity identifier.
Separates baseline, intervention or constraint, and observed outcome.
Records independent validation, alternative explanations, and the causal-inference boundary.
evidence_limits: The site-level generation audit is not a complete performance measure for every battery generator assigned to EIA plant code 260.
The regulator file independently validates that findings and responses exist, not the operating effect or durable closure of each item.
No ranking, composite score, readiness score, or causal estimate is supported.
